project.name: Open Period Care — Research & Knowledge Package

adapter.scope: Read-only VPS verification of the Open Period Care public research package through MyZubster/Zorgax evidence retrieval while preserving SUPPORTED evidence state and contributor credential boundaries.

steps: After explicit contributor opt-in, fetch the immutable public source commit into an isolated VPS verification directory.
Verify the Open Period Care research package, evidence matrix and Knowledge Card files resolve from the pinned commit.
Normalize only public research evidence required for the bounded semantic check.
Run a read-only MyZubster/Zorgax retrieval query for the contributor-scoped Knowledge Cards.
Verify KC-OPC-001 and KC-OPC-002 remain SUPPORTED and are not promoted to TESTED scientific or clinical evidence.
Verify the response does not infer medical licensing, clinical qualification or professional certification.
Capture only sanitized provenance-bearing outputs; perform no crawl, publication or write-back.
cleanup: Remove the isolated fetched working copy unless retained as immutable test evidence.
Remove temporary normalized/index artifacts created only for this verification run.
Do not modify production MyZubster data, contributor repositories or account-side Knowledge Card state.

checks: Pinned public commit 17cf7ca0a941d10e184771e574683785c1dbc8bf is fetched successfully.
Open Period Care evidence package is readable without credentials.
Contributor-scoped retrieval returns KC-OPC-001 and KC-OPC-002.
Both Knowledge Cards preserve evidence state SUPPORTED.
Unsupported personal certification or clinical qualification claims are blocked.
No crawling, publication, third-party send or production mutation occurs.

result.summary: MyZubster and Zorgax linkage is already documented and a prior contributor-scoped semantic bridge is TESTED, but a separate VPS external-project run has not been authorized or executed.

limitations: Existing MyZubster/Zorgax linkage does not automatically authorize a separate VPS external-project run.
SUPPORTED research evidence must not be promoted to scientific, clinical or certification TESTED state.
This verification does not establish medical licensing, clinical qualification, production readiness, payment, employment or partnership.
Knowledge Card and Contributor Passport publication remain separate owner-controlled actions.
